material_conditions: Construct linear and exponential functions, including arithmetic/geometric sequences, from graph, relation description or two input-output pairs (including a table).
Use graphs and tables to observe exponential growth eventually exceeds linear, quadratic and any general polynomial growth; do not infer mastery of general polynomial solving.
Interpret linear/exponential parameters in context; preserve source Mathematics I bracket naming exponential form f(x)=b^x+k separately from generalized exponentials.
